subject: Planner: Estimate to recognize modifyCount when all TopN collected (#55077)
summary: Reviewed the commit diff and nearby estimator code paths for point/range row-count estimation (column + index, stats v2). Change only affects cardinality estimation when Histogram.NDV is fully covered by TopN (histNDV<=0): if table ModifyCount>0, return a minimal non-zero estimate (1) instead of 0 to avoid treating unseen values as impossible when stats may be stale; otherwise keep returning 0. No plausible Blocker/High issues found in correctness/SQL semantics/data consistency/concurrency/session behavior since the change is confined to planner estimates (plan quality only) and clamps/scales results as before.
